advisories.basis: S-6 is typed `check` and marked '없음(정적 검사)', yet its action includes '재배포 1회 실행 후 `~/.opal/tools/brain-tool/brain_tool.py`를 ... diff'. That step runs the install script, which writes to the deployed copy at ~/.opal/, and then compares the result. It is not a static grep. The pass condition 'diff 결과가 빈 값' is set only after that run, so it is a behavioral check.
advisories.recommendation: Split S-6 into two scenarios. The grep and `git diff --name-only` steps stay as a static `check`. Make the redeploy and `diff` (D-12, C-4) a separate scenario with an execution type and timing 구현 후. That way a redeploy failure does not show up as a failed static check.
